title: Konjunktiv II for Advice
summary: Using könnte and sollte for suggestions and advice.
whyItMatters: Könnte and sollte make suggestions less direct and help distinguish an option from a stronger recommendation.

mentalModel.title: Könnte opens an option
mentalModel.content: Use könnte when one possible action may help.

mentalModel.title: Sollte recommends
mentalModel.content: Use sollte when you believe an action is advisable.

ruleBlocks.title: Conjugate the modal form
ruleBlocks.content: Use ich/er könnte or sollte, du könntest or solltest, and wir/sie könnten or sollten.

ruleBlocks.title: Put the action at the end
ruleBlocks.content: The second verb remains an infinitive at the end of the clause.

ruleBlocks.title: Match form to intention
ruleBlocks.content: Choose könnte for a gentle possibility and sollte for clearer advice.

examples.de: Du könntest mit kurzen Spaziergängen anfangen.
examples.en: You could start with short walks.

examples.de: Ihr solltet vor dem Training genug trinken.
examples.en: You should drink enough before training.

examples.de: Was könnte ich gegen Rückenschmerzen tun?
examples.en: What could I do about back pain?

commonMistakes.reason: The modal construction ends with infinitives.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use sollte for every casual option.
commonMistakes.correct: Use könnte when presenting a softer possibility.

comparisons.summary: Fitness routines provide practical advice contexts.
Conversation strategies help advice sound supportive rather than commanding.
